# Zipy

> > Zipy is an AI-powered platform for session replays, error tracking, real-time monitoring, and product analytics that helps developers debug production issues and optimize user experiences.

Zipy provides comprehensive frontend monitoring and debugging tools including AI-driven bug detection, session replay, performance tracking, and funnel analysis. The platform integrates with popular JavaScript frameworks like React, Vue, Angular, and Next.js, offering developers real-time insights into user behavior and application health.

## Key Topics

- Session Replay
- Error Tracking
- Real-User Monitoring
- Oopsie AI
- Performance Monitoring
- API Performance
- Stack Traces
- JavaScript Debugging
- DevTools Integration
- Funnel Analysis
- Heatmaps
- Console Logs
- Network Logs
- Real-Time Alerts
- Conversion Optimization

## Core Platform Features

- [Zipy: AI Session Replays, Error Tracking & Analytics](https://www.zipy.ai): Zipy platform: AI-powered session replays, error tracking, and analytics
- [Zipy Oopsie AI: Auto-Detect & Prioritize UI Bugs](https://www.zipy.ai/features/oopsie-ai-agent): Oopsie AI agent: auto-detect and prioritize UI bugs with video and traces
- [Fix User Issues Fast with Session Replay Tool](https://www.zipy.ai/features/session-replay-tool): Session replay tool: watch real user sessions to debug and optimize
- [Watch Users Live - Fix Issues Before They Leave](https://www.zipy.ai/features/real-user-monitoring): Real-user monitoring: live session watching and JavaScript error tracking

## Debugging & Error Analysis Tools

- [Debug JS Errors in Minutes with Stack Traces](https://www.zipy.ai/features/stack-traces): Stack traces: JavaScript error debugging with sourcemaps support
- [Debug Frontend Issues 10x Faster with Smart Logs](https://www.zipy.ai/features/console-logs): Console logs: monitor JavaScript errors and warnings in dashboard
- [Debug APIs Faster With Network Log Analysis](https://www.zipy.ai/features/network-logs): Network logs: API debugging with request/response analysis
- [Debug Production Issues with DevTools | Zipy](https://www.zipy.ai/features/advanced-dev-tools): DevTools integration: debug production issues with console and traces
- [Debug Faster: Find Any Error Session in Minutes](https://www.zipy.ai/features/advanced-filters-search): Advanced filters: locate error sessions by user ID or email instantly

## Performance & Monitoring

- [Stop Slow Pages: Real-Time API Performance Insights](https://www.zipy.ai/features/api-performance): API performance monitoring: real-time insights on slow APIs and latency
- [Website Pagespeed Optimization & Monitoring | Zipy](https://www.zipy.ai/features/pagespeed-tool): Pagespeed tool: Core Web Vitals tracking and performance optimization

## User Analytics & Conversion

- [Zipy Funnel Analysis - See Exactly Where You Are Losing Your Customer](https://www.zipy.ai/features/funnels): Funnel analysis: identify customer drop-off points with AI insights
- [Boost Conversions with Visual User Behavior Insights](https://www.zipy.ai/features/heatmaps): Heatmaps: visual user behavior analytics for conversion optimization
- [Identify User Churn with Smart User Identification](https://www.zipy.ai/features/user-identification): User identification: track and identify users to prevent churn

## Integrations & Alerts

- [Stop Bug Chaos: Instant Slack & Email Error Alerts](https://www.zipy.ai/features/slack-and-email-integration): Slack/Email integration: instant error alerts and notifications

- [Vue Error Monitoring for Devs – Debug Faster with Zipy](https://www.zipy.ai/framework/vuejs): Vue.js error monitoring: framework-specific debugging and insights
- [Angular Error Monitoring with Session Replays | Zipy](https://www.zipy.ai/framework/angular): Angular error monitoring: real-time alerts and session replays
- [Next.js Error Monitoring Tool | Zipy for Real-Time Debugging](https://www.zipy.ai/framework/nextjs): Next.js error monitoring: real-time debugging with performance insights
- [Online jQuery Debugger for Error Monitoring | Zipy AI](https://www.zipy.ai/framework/jquery): jQuery debugger: error monitoring and tracking for jQuery applications
